description:
Rooney Auctioneers are delighted to present No. 98 Caisleán na hAbhann, Castletroy, Co. Limerick to the market. This superb spacious residence is situated on a private and generously proportioned site within one of Castletroy’s most sought-after residential developments.

To the front, the property benefits from a driveway and garden area, while to the rear there is a private landscaped garden. The large rear garden also offers excellent potential for further extension, subject to the necessary planning permission. The accommodation comprises a bright and welcoming entrance hallway leading to a spacious reception room filled with natural light. To the rear, there is a large open-plan kitchen/dining area overlooking the garden. A generous utility room is located just off the kitchen with side access. On the first floor, there are three spacious bedrooms, including a superb main bedroom complete with ensuite bathroom and dressing room. A large main family bathroom is also located on this level. The second floor accommodates a further large double bedroom with ensuite bathroom and dressing room, with excellent storage space in the crawl space.

No. 98 Caisleán na hAbhann enjoys an enviable location within easy reach of an abundance of local amenities including the University of Limerick, Castletroy College, Monaleen National School & Milford National School. Residents are also well served by Castletroy Shopping Centre, a range of local shops, cafés, restaurants, and leisure facilities. For outdoor enthusiasts, Castletroy Golf Club and Castletroy Park are both nearby, while the property also benefits from easy access to the M7 motorway and all major road networks. No. 98 Caisleán na hAbhann represents a rare opportunity to acquire a superb family home in one of Limerick’s premier residential locations, combining generous accommodation, privacy, convenience, and outstanding local amenities.
